_doc: App index for AI/human modification. Read this before touching any file.
description: Client-side World Cup 2026 prediction pool for 12 friends. No backend, no auth, no database.
tech_stack: Vanilla HTML + CSS + JavaScript only. Zero npm. Zero build step. Zero dependencies.

files.index.html: HTML shell only. Header, nav (top desktop / bottom mobile), main#q-app mount point.
files.style.css: All styles. Mobile-first. Dark theme (#06060a) with gold (#c9992a) matching andresblitz.com. Bottom nav on mobile via @media max-width:640px.
files.app.js: Entire app: data constants, scoring engine, localStorage state, router, view renderers, event binders, export/import logic.

entry_point: index.html → app.js DOMContentLoaded → render() → checks S.nick → login or tabs

router.pattern: Single tab variable `tab` (string). navigate(tabName) switches tab and calls render().

state.engine: localStorage only — no cookies, no sessionStorage, no IndexedDB

keys.q_preds: object — { matchId: { h: number, a: number } } — current player's match predictions
keys.q_specials: object — { champion: string, runnerUp: string, topScorer: string }
keys.q_results: object — { matchId: { h: number, a: number } } — actual match results
keys.q_specres: object — { champion: string, runnerUp: string, topScorer: string } — actual awards
keys.q_players: array — [{ nick, preds, specials }] — imported friends' data

state.accessor: S object in app.js — S.nick, S.preds, S.specials, S.results, S.specRes, S.players

data_constants.MATCHES: Array of 72 objects: { id, g (group), h (home team), a (away team), d (YYYY-MM-DD), t (time ET) }
data_constants.F: Object mapping team name → emoji flag for all 48 teams
data_constants.ALL_TEAMS: Sorted array of all 48 team names
data_constants.TICKER_FACTS: Array of strings — rotating facts shown on standings page

rules.4pts: Correct result + correct goal difference (e.g. predicted 1-0, result 2-1)
rules.null: No prediction or no result yet

locking_logic.rule: Locks predictions when match date <= today (local date string YYYY-MM-DD comparison). Predictions locked on the day of the match. No timezone magic — simple, reliable.

views.login: loginHTML() + bindLogin() — nickname entry, no password
views.standings: standingsHTML() — ticker, live stats, leaderboard table, countdown to next match
views.picks: picksHTML() + bindPicks() — 72 matches grouped by matchday + date, stepper inputs
views.results: resultsHTML() + bindResults() — enter actual scores, final awards
views.share: shareHTML() + bindShare() — export JSON, import friend's JSON, remove player, reset

import_logic.note: When importing a friend's file, their results and specRes are merged into local storage via Object.assign. Whoever has more complete data wins. Import same nickname = update existing.

live_feeds.ticker: Rotating facts from TICKER_FACTS array, 5s interval, fade animation
live_feeds.stats: computeStats(results) — computes total goals, avg goals/match, top scoring team from entered results
live_feeds.countdown: nextMatch() — finds next unplayed match and shows time remaining
live_feeds.news_link: Links to official FIFA site, no API calls, no CORS issues

stepper_inputs.description: Score inputs use +/- stepper buttons (not number inputs). Min 44px touch target. Stores same data format as before.
stepper_inputs.function: stepperHTML(mid, side, val) returns button group HTML
stepper_inputs.binding: bindPicks() — delegates click on .q-step-btn, updates localStorage, updates DOM in-place

ui_notes.theme: Dark (#06060a bg, #c9992a gold) matching andresblitz.com. Football green (#22c55e) for positive scores.
ui_notes.fonts: Syne (headings/UI) + Syne Mono (mono data). Same as main site.
ui_notes.nav_mobile: Fixed bottom nav on screens <= 640px with safe-area-inset-bottom. Desktop: sticky top.
ui_notes.touch_targets: All interactive elements minimum 44x44px. Steppers are 52px height.
ui_notes.animations: Tab transitions: opacity+translateY, 200ms ease-out. Ticker: fade 300ms.

how_to_modify.add_match: Add object to MATCHES array in app.js. id must be unique. g=group, h=home, a=away, d=YYYY-MM-DD, t=time string.
how_to_modify.add_special: Add a card call in specialsHTML() and bind in bindSpecials(). Add key to S.specials getter/setter.
how_to_modify.add_ticker_fact: Push string to TICKER_FACTS array in app.js
how_to_modify.change_colors: Edit CSS custom properties in :root block of style.css
how_to_modify.add_tab: 1) Add button to .q-nav in index.html, 2) Add case to switch in render(), 3) Create viewHTML() + bindView() functions
how_to_modify.upgrade_to_firebase: Replace S getter/setters with Firestore reads/writes. Export/import flow becomes unnecessary.

known_limitations: No real-time sync — friends must share JSON files manually via WhatsApp/Telegram etc.
If two people enter conflicting results, last import wins (Object.assign merge)
Locking is date-based (not exact kickoff time) — predictions lock at midnight local time on match day
No validation that home+away team names are real — manual entry in results tab
localStorage is browser/device specific — same person on different devices has separate data
